TAS3D 2026 — Tashkent architecture visualisation forum

TAS3D 2026

Date

03.12.2026

Venue

Central Asian University in Tashkent — CAU

Format

Offline

Time

15:00 to 19:00

Who it’s for

  • ArchitectsArchitects need to know what’s happening in visualisation and graphics: it shapes how the client sees the project. You’ll learn which tools and neural networks studios already use and how to get from a sketch to a convincing image faster. And you can find visualisers for your projects.
  • 3D visualisersThis is where people who make visualisation every day get together. You’ll see how strong studios work and which techniques and tools they use, and understand where the profession is heading. It’s also a chance to meet colleagues and clients in person.
  • DesignersInterior and landscape designers need to understand how a project becomes an image and what affects the result. You’ll see the whole visualisation process: model, materials, light and final presentation. It helps you brief a visualiser more precisely or make the visuals yourself.
  • DevelopersVisualisation sells a project before it’s built. You’ll learn which formats work today, from still renders to real-time and animation, and what to look for when choosing a contractor. That makes decisions about a project’s visuals more confident.
  • StudentsStudies give you the basics, but it’s better to see the industry with your own eyes. Practitioners will show how real projects work and where to start a career. You can also meet studios here and make your first contacts in the profession.

FAQ

TAS3D 2026

Do I need to register?

Yes. Places are limited, so registration is required.

How much does it cost?

It’s free. You only need to register.

Is it suitable for beginners?

Yes. TAS3D is for everyone, from those just starting out to people who have been in the profession for years.

Can I talk to the speakers in person and ask questions?

Of course. There is a coffee break in the programme: the speakers spend it with the forum participants, so you can come up and ask your question.

How long will TAS3D 2026 last?

About 4–6 hours.

What language will the forum be in?

Russian and English. Talks by English-speaking speakers will be interpreted.

Do I need to bring anything?

Just your QR code. Luma will send it to you after you register: save it and show it at the entrance. Nothing else is needed, just come.

About

What is TAS3D

TAS3D is a forum in Tashkent(UZ) on 3D visualisation in architecture. One day of talks, workshops and conversations about how images help a project, from the first sketch to the client presentation. For architects, visualisers, designers and developers.

TAS3D is one of the largest forums on architectural visualisation and artificial intelligence. Every year we bring together visualisers, architects, designers, 3D artists and developers to discuss where the industry is heading and how new technologies are changing the profession today.

At TAS3D you will learn how neural networks speed up project work, which rendering and real-time visualisation tools set the trends, and how to turn your skills into a successful career or your own studio. The speakers are world-class practitioners who share real cases, workflows and craft secrets, not theory.

It is more than lectures. It is live conversation, networking with industry leaders, workshops, portfolio reviews and the chance to find like-minded people, clients and partners.
